Alex’s Tuesday unfolded as a day where moderate psychological safety and team trust allowed his naturally cautious curiosity to surface more fully. This constructive momentum lifted his engagement well above baseline, making today one of his better, more fulfilling days marked by thoughtful contributions and measured creative expression.
